flows.name: discover_and_stage
steps: enumerate only governed candidate files for the source family
stability/security inspect before parsing
select candidate deterministically under source-family chronology rules
parse with versioned header/field registry and bounded resource policy
normalize allowlisted source meaning
compute logical fingerprint
persist bounded ImportRun/SourceObservation evidence
produce diff/proposal without domain mutation

flows.name: review_and_accept
steps: load proposal against current accepted domain revision
classify targets as safe, warning, high-risk, conflict, unresolved or invalid
auto-accept only an explicitly registered low-risk class
operator reviews remaining smallest safe target scopes
accepted target invokes owning-domain command
owning domain revalidates current state and commits its mutation/audit atomically
record proposal disposition and advance source checkpoint only consistently with accepted import work

flows.name: replay
steps: compare source chronology and logical fingerprint to accepted checkpoint
exact replay returns no domain mutation
newer identical logical content may update bounded recency/checkpoint evidence
equal chronology with differing content becomes conflict
older evidence enters explicit reviewed recovery and never silently rewinds accepted truth

flows.name: partial_failure
steps: workbook-level integrity/identity/safety failure rejects the run before mutation
target-local duplicate/conflict/validation defects remain isolated when the rest is independently explainable
identityless logical rows fabricate no entity
rejected/deferred/unresolved targets preserve source presence without fabricating disappearance
